description: How SMS collapsed while WhatsApp, WeChat and Telegram exploded — a 2006–2026 story of migration, policy shocks and viral surges in global messaging.
youtube_description:
From the heyday of SMS to the instant, encrypted apps that run our lives — this timeline shows the real migration. SMS users peaked in the early 2010s, then declined as mobile internet and rich messaging apps took over. WhatsApp and WeChat became global behemoths; Telegram exploded after 2021 policy shocks and privacy-driven migrations; Signal had viral spikes but smaller long-term scale. This video uses real historical milestones (WhatsApp hitting ~2B users in 2020, Tencent reporting WeChat growth, Telegram's official 500M milestone in 2021 and subsequent growth surges, and SMS decline as smartphone messaging grew) to tell a dramatic chart-race story.

Watch the bars fly — notice the moment SMS drops and Telegram’s rally and WhatsApp’s steady climb. If you want raw data for your own edits, comment below. Smash like, subscribe, and ring the bell for more chart-race deep dives.

Sources: company user announcements (WhatsApp, Telegram, Tencent), industry reports and public filings, major coverage of the 2021 WhatsApp policy backlash and subsequent Telegram/Signal surges.

Call to action: Like + Subscribe for weekly viral timelines. Comment which messaging app you still use.
